q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
Let me work through this carefully.

**(a) Time left until resolution:**
The question asks about NVIDIA's forward guidance issued in the Q2 FY2027 earnings release on August 26, 2026. Today is August 20, 2026, so resolution is 6 days away.

**(b) Most likely outcome and why:**

The question is asking for NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q3 FY2027 revenue that will be announced on August 26, 2026.

From the research provided:
- NVIDIA issued prior guidance on May 20, 2026 for Q2 FY2027 revenue of $91.0 billion ± 2%, which translates to a range of $89.2B–$92.8B
- Wall Street analysts have an average estimate of $91.9 billion for Q2 FY2027 actual results
- This guidance excluded Data Center compute revenue from China

NVIDIA typically provides forward guidance as a point estimate plus/minus 2%. Based on the pattern and Wall Street expectations for Q2 FY2027 actual results (~$91.9B), I would expect Q3 FY2027 guidance to reflect sequential growth typical for NVIDIA.

Historically, NVIDIA shows strong sequential growth in data center revenue. Assuming Q2 FY2027 comes in near the $91.9B consensus estimate, Q3 FY2027 guidance would likely reflect:
- Continued demand for AI/data center products
- Typical seasonal patterns (Q3 is often strong)
- Potential upside from China easing restrictions (though this is uncertain)

A reasonable projection would be mid-to-high single digit sequential growth from the $91.9B Q2 level, pointing toward guidance in the $100B–$105B range for Q3 FY2027.

**(c) What would push the value lower?**
- Deterioration in customer demand or data center orders
- Macro economic weakness affecting cloud provider spending
- Continued China restrictions without relaxation
- Supply chain disruptions
- Competition intensifying more than expected

**(d) What would push the value higher?**
- Stronger than expected demand for AI chips
- China restrictions being lifted, opening significant new revenue
- Better than anticipated execution on new product releases
- Cloud providers accelerating capex spending
- Market share gains from competitors

**(e) Base rate or historical reference values:**

From the research:
- Q2 FY2027 guidance was $91.0B ± 2% ($89.2B–$92.8B)
- Wall Street consensus for Q2 FY2027 actual: $91.9B
- The range given in the question is $99.5B–$115.5B, suggesting market expectations for potential Q3 guidance

Given NVIDIA's historical patterns of strong sequential growth in data center-driven quarters, and assuming Q2 comes in near consensus, Q3 FY2027 guidance in the $100B–$107B range appears most likely, with potential for higher if China restrictions ease.

The midpoint of the provided range ($107.5B) may reflect upside scenarios including China, but a more conservative baseline would be around $103B–$105B for Q3 FY2027 guidance.

Weighing all factors:
- Most likely: ~$104B (modest 13% sequential growth from Q2 ~$91.9B)
- 10th percentile: ~$100B (slower growth, macro headwinds)
- 90th percentile: ~$110B (strong growth, possible China tailwinds)

The company's prior guidance, issued on May 20, 2026, for Q2 FY2027, projected revenue of $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm). This guidance did not include any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/), [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027/).

Wall Street analysts, per Yahoo! Finance, have an average estimate for Q2 FY2027 revenue at $91.9 billion [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). This falls within NVIDIA's guidance range of $89.2 billion to $92.8 billion [fool.com](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/19/nvidia-guided-to-usd91-billion-wall-street-penciled-in-usd92-billion/). For the full fiscal year 2027, NVIDIA anticipates GAAP and non-GAAP tax rates between 16.0% and 18.0% [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/).
